request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "**Migration report**", "2": "**What worked:** Standardizing V05's year-over-year change against its own expanding history gave a modestly positive rank IC (about 0.06, HAC t 2.2).", "3": "Correlation with base features was low.", "4": "Lagging it one month weakened the signal (IC 0.04, t 1.4), so freshness matters.", "5": "Signal strength appeared stronger when T was high.", "6": "**What failed:** Counting the share of recent months in which V05 rose (six-month persistence) gave a negative IC (about -0.07, t -1.8).", "7": "It contradicted my hypothesis and has high rank autocorrelation.", "8": "Standardizing V03 against its expanding history produced essentially zero IC and weak coverage.", "9": "**Caveat:** Coverage of the best feature is only about 63%, and its sign was opposite to my stated hypothesis, so treat it cautiously."}, "hypothesis": "Groups with V03 high relative to V04, both standardized on a 60-month window and lightly smoothed over 3 months, will have higher next-month returns, extending the only significant positive result (submission 4) with modest noise reduction.", "expression": "spread(mavg(tsz(V03,60),3),mavg(tsz(V04,60),3))"}
